sections.title: Six certificates, two entities, three standards
sections.text: Held twice: once by the Singapore parent, once by the Bangladesh company, which is audited independently by TÜV AUSTRIA.
sections.note: The Bangladesh scope names process and plant control system and automation explicitly. Valid to August 2027.

sections.title: How to read any certificate, ours included
items: Entity: which legal company is named?
Scope: does it cover your kind of work?
Accreditation: who certified it, and are they IAF accredited?

sections.title: QA/QC on every project
sections.text: Quality is planned, not inspected in at the end. Every project runs to an inspection and test plan agreed up front: material traceability on pressure parts, witnessed factory acceptance tests before shipment, site acceptance tests at commissioning, and a documentation dossier — datasheets, certificates, test records and as-builts — handed over at the close.

sections.title: Health, safety & environment
sections.text: We work to a health, safety and environment management system covering risk assessment, permit-to-work, toolbox talks and incident reporting on every site. Safe delivery is a condition of the work, not a trade-off against the schedule.

sections.title: Let's discuss your next project
sections.text: Tell us what you are planning. An engineer will reply, not a sales queue.
